declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through adversarial, arm’s-length negotiations between class counsel and Brightline’s counsel over multiple rounds. The parties exchanged and revised complete settlement proposals before reaching agreement. The negotiations addressed class relief and attorneys’ fees as components of the proposed settlement package; fees were not first discussed only after class relief had been agreed. The agreed class fund is for automatic distribution using Brightline’s records. Attorneys’ fees are separate from the class fund, remain subject to the Court’s approval, and are not protected by a clear-sailing commitment. Any fee amount the Court does not award reverts to Brightline. I do not disclose confidential mediation communications or the parties’ negotiating positions.

backchannel.speaker: plaintiff
backchannel.message: We’re prepared to engage constructively toward a resolution that delivers meaningful, direct relief to the identified members. Given Brightline’s records, automatic distribution should be a priority. It would be helpful to understand your client’s settlement priorities and the range of authority you have for a complete term sheet.

We can negotiate a complete package, including a reasonable fee request subject to court approval, but I’m not in a position to state a settlement range at this stage. Please send your proposed terms.
